scripts.dev:full: bunx convex dev --local --start 'bun run --filter client dev'
scripts.dev:full:host: bunx convex dev --local --start 'bun run --filter client dev:host'
scripts.dev:online: bunx convex dev --local --start 'bun run --filter server dev & bun run --filter client dev'
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter client typecheck && bun run --filter server typecheck && bun run typecheck:convex
scripts.build:standalone: bun run --filter client build && bun tools/build-standalone.mjs
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run build
